title: `sys_position`'s clone-dialog helpText still asserts unqualified uniqueness in es-ES/ja-JP/zh-CN
body:
Measured on `origin/main` while implementing #8601 (which corrects the sibling leaf, `sys_position.fields.name.help`).

`sys_position` carries **two** leaves that state the machine-name uniqueness rule, and #8468 corrected **both** at source. Only one of them is in #8601's dispatched scope. The second one — the `clone_position` action's `name` parameter helpText — is still stale in the same three locales, in the same way.

## Source (already correct)

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-position.object.ts:116`

```
{ name: 'name', label: 'New API Name', type: 'text', required: true, helpText: 'snake_case machine name, unique per organization' }
```

The comment immediately above it, at `:112-114`, is explicit that this is #8468's doing: *"The clone dialog is where an admin types a NEW position name ... the name must be free within THIS organization, not across"*.

## Shipped bundles — `sys_position.actions.clone_position.params.name.helpText`

| locale | line | shipped today | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `en` | `:99` | `"snake_case machine name, unique per organization"` | correct, matches source verbatim |
| `es-ES` | `:99` | `"Nombre de máquina snake_case único"` | «único», unqualified |
| `ja-JP` | `:99` | `"一意の snake_case マシン名"` | 「一意」, unqualified |
| `zh-CN` | `:99` | `"唯一的 snake_case 机器名称"` | 「唯一」, unqualified |

The declared index is `{ fields: ['name'], unique: 'organization' }` (`sys-position.object.ts:314`), so all three tell an admin the clone's API name must be free installation-wide, which is not what is enforced. This is the same defect class as #8601, one leaf over, and it is the leaf an admin reads at exactly the moment they are typing a new name.

## Why the gate is silent

Same reason as #8601: `check:i18n` is green either way, because merge mode never updates an existing value (#8543). No gate will surface this.

## Fix

Leaf string values only, three files, per the bundle header workflow. The idiom is already established in these same files by PR #8599 — `sys_permission_set`'s equivalent param at `:277` reads `"Nombre de máquina snake_case, único por organización"` / `"snake_case マシン名（組織ごとに一意）"` / `"snake_case 机器名称，在每个组织内唯一"`, so this is a copy of a phrasing the repo has already accepted.

## Why this is filed rather than folded into #8601

The #8601 dispatch pinned the file surface to `sys_position.fields.name.help`, "nothing else", with an explicit instruction to stop on breach and explain in the report. It is a three-line change in the three files that PR already touches, so folding it in is cheap if the PM prefers that — this card exists so the decision is the PM's rather than mine.

## Related

- #8601 — the sibling leaf, in flight.
- #8556 / #8468 — where the source was corrected.
- #8543 — the generator defect that lets this drift survive silently.
